chapter: The Gallery (savanna, levels 11-20) - regenerated on the owner's ruling of 2026-10-11 (#706): the offenders named by measurement against the desert's ember family are replaced, keeping the savanna voice and taking from ember a lead line the ear can follow, the character carried by arrangement and drive, not noise
purpose: Master of Game/Music/mural-jive.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-706-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate in masters-706); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-mural.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

bake.why: #706: the master's crest factor is 16.8 dB (peak +3.3 dBFS at -13.5 dBFS RMS) and its peaks are round, not flat (no run of 3 samples within 0.1 dB of its peak). Brought to -15 dBFS RMS, 1061 samples went over full scale and decoded to 40 clipped runs (decoded peak +0.14 dBFS); trimmed 1.5 dB, to 1 run (ember's range 0-3) and a peak of +0.01 dBFS, at -15.6 LUFS against the family's -15.1 to -13.3. Trimmed 2.0 dB it decoded to 0 runs at -16.1 LUFS; the smaller cut was kept for the loudness

chosen.why: the one candidate of eight renders (two rounds) inside ember's range on every column: 200 Hz-2 kHz 12.1 % (the old loop 9.3 %), 300 Hz-4 kHz 10.2 %, 0.9 % above 6 kHz (the old loop 5.4 %), tonal mid 52 %, 3.62 held-note changes a second; a 40 s loop recut from c4's render before the band's two-second stop (c4's own 108 s cut carried it as a 23.5 dB dropout), context match 0.93, crossfade r 0.98 against 0.75 a bar later, spectrum cos 0.96, wrap step -2.5 dB (p6). Every other render kept 2.3-4.5 % above 6 kHz, round 2's darker brief (mellow round guitar, soft highs, low hand drums, jangly guitar and crisp hi-hats in the negative) included. Its master's crest factor of 16.8 dB decoded to 40 clipped runs at the themes' loudness, so the bake trims it 1.5 dB (bake.trim_db). Its pitch wobble measures 3.9 cents, a tenth over ember's 3.8 (the old loop 3.2): inside the detune range, named here because 'drunk' is the complaint
chosen.how: every candidate measured with Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember in one run (band shares, tonal mid, mid flatness, held-note changes, tempo wander, wrap step) beside the loop cut's own check, the hole share (the loop more than 10 dB under its loud level), the breakdown dip and the stereo correlation; a seam below its own rhythm, a hole over 15 % of the loop, a 2 s dropout more than 20 dB down, a wrap step of 10 dB or more or at p97 or above of the loop's own steps, a seam spectrum cosine under 0.3 or a loop under 30 s ruled a candidate out; the table is on #706
